scope: Full4834-frame Dev, not Test. All registered rows and failures retained. Cached replay speed excludes pixel/encoder preparation and is not end-to-end FPS.
note: All18 controls include six complete RGB-only memory references. Generic RGB memory itself hurts some seeds; exact native-zero parity is therefore necessary but insufficient to establish a strong baseline.

config.registration: Registered before ordered memory replay. First apply complete frozen RGB real/null memory to unreturned new IDs; only then consult auxiliary evidence for the remaining unclaimed observations/old IDs. Both phases precede first output, use past/current only and preserve every previously returned ID. Compare all12 paired encoder/head controls and six complete RGB memory controls; no Test selection.
